cause: QRS detector adapts its threshold to noise and counts noise as beats; search-back accepts a T wave as a beat
hazardous_situation: Patient in cardiac standstill, monitor shows a heart rate and stays silent
harm: Death or irreversible injury from delayed resuscitation
controls: Absolute threshold floor (0.2 mV-equivalent); T-wave window excluded from search-back; asystole timer on validated beats only
residual_note: Ventricular fibrillation is not classified by this prototype (out of scope); coarse VF may be counted as beats.

cause: Alarm path delayed by lower-criticality software (display, logging, other processes) through CPU contention
hazardous_situation: Alarm condition detected internally but output delayed by an unbounded time
controls: Fixed-priority preemptive scheduling with alarm manager highest; event-driven (non-polled) alarm path; 10 ms hard deadline verified under overload
residual_note: Bound demonstrated empirically on the evaluation platform only; a certified RTOS/board latency bound is required for a product.

cause: Priority inversion: display thread holds a mutex needed by the processing thread and is pre-empted by unrelated load
hazardous_situation: Processing thread blocked for an unbounded time
controls: Priority-inheritance protocol on every shared mutex; critical sections limited to fixed-size copies

cause: Page fault, heap allocation or file I/O inside a real-time thread
hazardous_situation: Real-time thread suspended on a kernel service with unbounded duration
controls: All buffers pre-allocated before the real-time phase; memory locked (mlockall); logs written only after the run

hazard: Physiological data silently lost or stale
cause: Processing thread hangs (runaway loop) or acquisition stops
hazardous_situation: Waveform frozen, no physiological alarm can be generated
harm: Missed alarm; death or serious injury
controls: Independent watchdog thread above the supervised threads; SYS_STALL HIGH-priority technical alarm within 200 ms
residual_note: A stalled alarm-manager thread or a kernel hang is not covered: an external hardware watchdog is required.

hazardous_situation: Gaps in the ECG seen by the detector; beats missed or mis-timed
controls: Bounded queue with drop counter; DATA_LOSS technical alarm on any drop; queue sized for 1 s of backlog

hazard: False asystole alarm after lead reconnection
cause: Saturation transient drives the adaptive threshold far above true QRS amplitude
harm: Alarm fatigue leading to a missed true alarm
controls: Hold-last-value during saturation; blanking and threshold re-learning after reconnection; bounded single-beat influence on the threshold

cause: ECG rhythm alarms are inhibited while electrodes are disconnected
hazardous_situation: Patient deteriorates while ECG is invalid
controls: LEADS_OFF technical alarm within 0.5 s; independent pulse supervision through PPG perfusion (LOW_PERF); asystole detected within 10 s of reconnection even if thresholds were learnt on noise
residual_note: LEADS_OFF is MEDIUM and LOW_PERF is LOW priority; escalation when both are present is a recommended extension.

cause: Ratio-of-ratios evaluated on noise when the pulse is absent or perfusion is very low (R tends to 1, i.e. 85 %)
hazardous_situation: Plausible but meaningless SpO2 numeric shown
harm: Hypoxaemia not recognised or unnecessary intervention
controls: Perfusion-index validity gate: numeric blanked and SpO2 limit alarms suppressed, LOW_PERF raised
residual_note: Empirical calibration curve and motion artefact are not modelled.

cause: Desaturation detector fails or is delayed
hazardous_situation: Sustained SpO2 below limit without alarm
controls: Two-level SpO2 limits with bounded persistence times (5 s / 10 s)

hazard: High-priority alarm hidden by lower-priority alarm
cause: Annunciation follows the most recent instead of the most severe alarm
hazardous_situation: HIGH-priority condition presented with a MEDIUM/LOW signal
controls: Priority arbitration over all active alarms on every state change

cause: Alarm clears automatically when the condition ends before staff attend
hazardous_situation: Self-terminating asystole or tachycardia leaves no trace
controls: Latching of HIGH-priority physiological alarms until operator acknowledgement; ongoing conditions cannot be dismissed
residual_note: Audio-pause and alarm-limit configuration are not implemented.

cause: Detector false positives or negatives on normal rhythm; rate estimate unstable
harm: Alarm fatigue leading to a missed true alarm
controls: Detector performance requirements; 4-beat averaging with hysteresis on rate limits; persistence times on SpO2 limits
residual_note: Verified on synthetic signals only; clinical false-alarm rate is unknown.

cause: Sampling jitter or drift distorts RR intervals and persistence timers
hazardous_situation: Heart-rate and timing-based conditions evaluated on a wrong time base
controls: Absolute-time periodic release; timers counted in sample indices, not wall-clock reads
